name: Michael Hallquist, PhD
bio: Michael Hallquist is a Professor in the Department of Psychology at Emory University. His research program integrates transdiagnostic dimensional models, cognitive neuroscience, and computational psychiatry to understand how learning, decision-making, and emotion shape individual differences in personality and psychopathology. To support this work, he also develops and applies statistical and computational methods for psychometric, behavioral, and neuroimaging data, including latent variable and reinforcement learning models.
background: Before joining Emory University in 2026, he was a Professor at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He received his B.A. in psychology from the University of Wisconsin–Madison in 2002, earned his Ph.D. in clinical psychology from SUNY–Binghamton in 2009, and completed his clinical internship and postdoctoral training at Western Psychiatric Institute and Clinic in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

name: Abigale Collins
bio: Abigale studies social and emotional decision-making and the neural mechanisms of psychopathology.
